risks.risk: Whether the machine is actually functional (timing, feed, needle bar movement, and motor performance under load). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: Short video: power on + sewing a straight line on fabric (with thread) showing consistent feed and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly needing service (worst case for a remote buyer).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories/manual (common with used industrial machines).
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out + close-up of manual cover/first pages.

risks.risk: Drive type mismatch (seller says direct drive; photo does not confirm).
risks.proof: Photo showing the drive configuration clearly (beltless/direct coupling area) or a close-up of the motor-to-hookup connection.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the less certain configuration (treat as standard used industrial machine without assuming direct-drive advantage).

risks.risk: Country-of-origin/brand authenticity (seller says Japanese made; not visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating plate/serial plate showing manufacturer and country.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming Japanese origin premium.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one angle (rust, worn feed dogs, oil leaks, electrical faults).
risks.proof: Multiple photos: underside/bed, feed dog area, needle plate, and any visible wiring/controls; plus a brief run test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential wear (worst case within typical used condition).

proof_requests: Power-on + sewing video on fabric (straight stitch) showing smooth operation and consistent feed.
Close-up of the machine’s rating/serial plate (brand, model, country of manufacture).
Photos of all accessories and the manual laid out; include manual cover/first page.
Close-up of the drive/motor connection area to confirm direct-drive vs belt/other setup.
Additional condition photos: needle area, feed dogs, underside/bed, and any wiring/electrical connections.
response.reason: The photo only confirms a machine marking that looks like “EM81” but does not verify direct-drive, Japanese origin, or that the motor/machine actually works smoothly. Without a run test and clear identity plate/accessories proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
